### 44 tests passed with no failures, including all 17 differential tests. Those 17 had never executed on Windows before: the harness resolved the sibling akr binary without EXE_SUFFIX, so every one of them asserted 'is not built' before running. They pass now, so the CLI-and-MCP agreement this suite exists to hold is checked on Windows for the first time. It also covers a new case, knowledge_explain_and_akr_explain_agree.

### a_current_index_search_does_not_invoke_git passed in a 10-test run of the akr-cli search suite. It builds the index, then runs akr search with PATH pointed at an empty directory, so a git subprocess could not be found if one were attempted; the command exits 0 and returns results. The fast path is structurally git-free rather than merely quick, and this pass's akr-cli and akr-mcp changes did not disturb it.
